entities.summary: Nils Gyldenstolpe was a Swedish count, official and diplomat. He was one of king Karl XI's closest advisors and owed much of his career to Bengt Gabrielsson Oxenstierna. His father was Mikael Olai Wexionius Gyldenstolpe.
